items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Punch Miller was one of the Jack Carey famous trumpet players.

ctx.x: Did you work much with Punch down here?

By the way, on that Jack Carey, that's who was the trumpet player mostly, Lee Collins and Punch Miller. Punch Miller was one of the Jack Carey famous trumpet players. I couldn't think of the trumpet players. See?
Did you work any panels of music?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: when I made it in Mexico with Edwin Hall

ctx.x: No. I just thought maybe you knew some of the different guys that worked with him. No,

see he always worked at Spanish Food, that's where he always worked. And we never did go out there, we went to Millenburg, pretty like that, but I never did go to Spanish Food. I don't know, you don't even know the place where he worked at out there. Did you ever work with B-Rod? Yeah. How'd that happen? You mean, playing in the band with him? Well no, we made records on one side, he made them on the other side, but we were always in the same building, in New York, when I made it in Mexico with Edwin Hall. Yeah.…
Met him in New York or in California? No, New York. I see. Did you ever know Richard M Jones?
